newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Howard tips red and white in football finals.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Howard tips red and white in football finals.

text.p: Australian Prime Minister John Howard has tipped narrow wins by the Sydney Swans and St George in the AFL and Australian Rugby League grand finals this weekend.
"I'm going for a red and white double ... St George by four or five, Sydney by 10," Howard told a business luncheon.
The Sydney Swans meet North Melbourne in the AFL grand final in Melbourne on Saturday and St George plays Manly in the Australian Rugby League grand final on Sunday.
Howard's tipped teams' colours are red and white in both football codes.
